title: V5 lab: Python seal console — RPC steps + dual-node log JSON window
brief: Separate from pwmd Rust slice: external Python harness (MCP-friendly) that agents/operators invoke instead of raw curl. One command returns a unified JSON document: RPC response from proposer lab/seal API plus structured log events from proposer AND attester captured in the same time window as the step. Stdlib-only; JSON/JSONL on stdout for tooling and subagents.

design.name: cy_lab_seal_console
design.problem: Manual RPC step debug still forces agents to correlate three surfaces: HTTP response, proposer log, attester log. Owner restarts cluster; agents need a single machine-readable window per step, not grep across terminals.

single_window_contract.description: Every invocation emits one top-level JSON object (pretty optional) with stable schema_version

top_level_fields.ok: bool — RPC ok AND parse success
top_level_fields.rpc: parsed JSON body from proposer HTTP (or error envelope)
top_level_fields.summary: short human hint + counts by event kind

log_event_model.event_id: stable hash or increment per line
log_event_model.fields: key-value dict parsed from line (regex tables, extensible)

design.parser_reuse: Extend patterns from scripts/_review_seal_log_analytics.py; add manual_seal_*, cluster_attest_*, waiting_sync, quorum_timeout, continuity_break, ClusterPropose/Attest peer lines

log_discovery.policy: latest mtime among matches; warn if multiple active

rpc_client.timeout_note: gate_wait step may use up to 120s

cli_surface.style: MCP-adjacent: subcommand + --json (default on) + optional --jsonl for watch

watch_mode.purpose: Agent loop: emit JSONL lines {type: log_event|heartbeat} from both tails without blocking on RPC

stdio_jsonl_protocol.optional_phase: Document in runbook for future MCP wrapper: stdin one JSON cmd per line, stdout one JSON response per line (same schema as CLI step)
stdio_jsonl_protocol.note: Phase 1: argparse CLI; Phase 2 (non-blocking nits): thin scripts/cy_lab_seal_mcp_stdio.py shim if owner wants Cursor MCP tool

agent_ergonomics.exit_code: 0 ok, 1 rpc fail, 2 log missing, 3 parse/config

acceptance_criteria: After depends_on RPC lands: step preflight --verbose returns one JSON with rpc.* and window.proposer/attester.events non-empty when cluster running
Events in window bracket match wall time of RPC call (no unbounded full-file read; byte offset or line cursor persisted in optional state file tmp/cy-lab-seal-console.state.json)
discover subcommand returns JSON with resolved log paths + rpc reachability
watch emits valid JSONL; kinds include cluster_attest and manual_seal when verbose RPC used
docs/runbooks/v5-cy-lab-seal-console.md with agent copy-paste flow (attester first, manual_rpc, step chain)
Unit tests: scripts/_test_cy_lab_seal_console.py — parser fixtures from snippets (no live cluster required)

delegations.prompt_summary: Implement cy_lab_seal_console.py + runbook + parser tests; JSON window over RPC + dual-node logs
Review schema stability, no secrets in JSON output, safe localhost-only assumptions documented
Verify Python console py_compile + 6 unit tests (including test_normalize_seal_control_mode NIT-3 fix)
